'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Reid Smith DS A Stunning Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Reid Smith]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Sheet '''R Smith''' / deck '''Blow Me Backwards'''; username '''3MW0J8'''; dest [[Reid Smith]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage]]
* '''Username:''' 3MW0J8
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
